measurement_method: Record lodging angle, lodging incidence, plant height, internode diameter, stem breaking strength, and plot yield under dense planting.
scale_or_unit: 1-9 lodging score; percentage; cm; N; kg/plot
replication: RCBD with at least 3 replicates; include donor, recurrent parent, F1/BC/F2 material as available
decision_thresholds: Advance only if lodging score improves and yield is not materially reduced versus recurrent parent.
risk_notes: Single-season data should be treated as preliminary.
notes: Primary phenotyping protocol for dense-planting lodging validation.

measurement_method: Record days to heading, anthesis window, pollen shed overlap, seed set, and maturity date.
replication: At least 2 sowing windows when crossing synchrony is uncertain
decision_thresholds: Do not advance a cross route if flowering windows cannot be synchronized without extra nursery management.
risk_notes: May need adjustment by photoperiod and seasonal temperature.
notes: Supports risk review for crossing feasibility.

measurement_method: Record emergence, canopy temperature, stay-green score, leaf rolling, biomass, grain yield, and recovery after rewatering.
replication: Irrigated control plus managed drought block with at least 3 replicates
decision_thresholds: Advance only if drought block yield and stay-green improve without unacceptable yield loss in irrigated control.
risk_notes: Soil heterogeneity and stress timing must be controlled.
notes: Synthetic protocol row for drought workflow tests.

measurement_method: Score leaf and neck blast severity, infection type, plant stage, and yield loss under susceptible spreader rows.
replication: Resistant check, susceptible check, and candidate lines in replicated nursery
decision_thresholds: Advance only if disease score is consistently lower than susceptible check and agronomic penalty is acceptable.
risk_notes: Nursery escape, pathogen race, and uneven inoculum pressure require checks.
notes: Synthetic protocol row for disease workflow tests.

trait: grain quality; protein content; starch quality
measurement_method: Measure thousand-grain weight, crude protein, amylose or starch profile, color, and basic processing preference score.
scale_or_unit: g; percentage; lab assay units; 1-9 score
replication: At least two biological replicates per line plus recurrent parent and quality donor checks
decision_thresholds: Advance only if target quality improves without severe yield or maturity penalty.
risk_notes: Small seed lots and environment effects can bias quality assays.
notes: Synthetic protocol row for quality workflow tests.

measurement_method: Record days to heading, days to maturity, plant height, panicle traits, and grain yield across sowing dates.
replication: Two sowing dates and at least 3 replicates when seed allows
decision_thresholds: Advance only if maturity is earlier while maintaining acceptable yield and flowering synchrony.
risk_notes: Too-early maturity may reduce biomass and yield potential.
notes: Synthetic protocol row for short-season adaptation tests.

measurement_method: Expose matched seedlings or plants to controlled complete submergence, then score survival, recovery, plant height, panicle fertility, and grain yield against non-submerged controls.
scale_or_unit: survival percentage; recovery score; days; percentage seed set; kg/plot
replication: Randomized complete block design with at least 3 replicates; include tolerant and susceptible checks
decision_thresholds: Advance only when survival and recovery improve after the target flood duration without unacceptable yield or maturity penalty.
risk_notes: Water depth, temperature, duration, recovery weather, and check performance must be standardized.
notes: Source-backed protocol seed for Sub1 route.

trait: drought avoidance; root architecture; grain yield
measurement_method: Measure root growth angle or root depth and pair it with canopy status, flowering, grain yield, and irrigated-control performance under managed drought.
replication: At least 3 replicates with irrigated and drought blocks; soil profile recorded
decision_thresholds: Advance only if root architecture and drought-block yield improve without a major irrigated-control penalty.
risk_notes: Soil texture, rooting depth measurement, stress timing, and background effects can confound the route.
notes: Source-backed protocol seed for DRO1 route.

target_environment: saline or sodic seedling and field trial
measurement_method: Score salt injury at seedling stage, survival, plant height, panicle fertility, and yield under stress versus non-stress control.
scale_or_unit: 1-9 injury score; survival percentage; cm; percentage seed set; kg/plot
replication: Replicated stress and control blocks with tolerant and susceptible checks
decision_thresholds: Reject or revise if seedling tolerance does not persist to reproductive-stage fertility and yield.
risk_notes: Electrical conductivity, sodium distribution, irrigation timing, and soil heterogeneity must be recorded.
notes: Source-backed protocol seed for Saltol route.

measurement_method: Challenge candidate lines with relevant local Magnaporthe isolates and record leaf or neck blast severity, infection type, disease escape risk, and yield penalty.
scale_or_unit: disease severity score; infection type; percentage; kg/plot
replication: Replicated nursery with susceptible spreader rows, resistant and susceptible checks, and isolate identity recorded
decision_thresholds: Advance only when resistance is consistent across relevant isolates and agronomic penalty remains acceptable.
risk_notes: Pathogen race specificity and uneven inoculum can create false confidence from marker-only selection.
notes: Source-backed protocol seed for Pi-ta and other blast routes.

measurement_method: Inoculate candidate lines with local Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae isolates and record lesion length, disease progression, and yield or fertility effects.
scale_or_unit: lesion length cm; disease score; percentage; kg/plot
replication: Replicated nursery with susceptible check, resistant check, and isolate identity recorded
decision_thresholds: Advance only when Xa21 or other candidate resistance remains effective against the target isolate set.
risk_notes: Local Xoo population and isolate mixture can change resistance expression.
notes: Source-backed protocol seed for Xa21 route.

measurement_method: Measure apparent amylose, grain dimensions, chalkiness, gelatinization or pasting traits, and replicated cooking or sensory proxy measurements.
scale_or_unit: percentage amylose; mm; percentage chalkiness; lab units; score
replication: At least 2 biological samples per line plus quality checks and moisture normalization
decision_thresholds: Advance only if the target quality range is met without unacceptable yield, maturity, or milling penalty.
risk_notes: Consumer preference and environment can shift the relationship between genotype, amylose, and eating quality.
notes: Source-backed protocol seed for Wx quality route.
